instructions: Canonical 10-intent taxonomy manually curated from the 21 raw HDBSCAN cluster proposals. Clusters merged/renamed per Hiver assignment canonical categories.

clusters.label: audio_playback
clusters.definition: Music pausing unexpectedly, buffering, stuttering, sound cut-offs, volume issues, or songs stopping when switching apps or receiving notifications.
clusters.example: @SpotifyCares why does spotify pause my music everytime i try to go to another app?
sample_messages: @SpotifyCares why does spotify pause my music everytime i try to go to another app?
@SpotifyCares Hi. @115888 keeps pausing on me randomly. Help?
@SpotifyCares My music keeps pausing, saying my account is in use elsewhere.
@SpotifyCares hey my app and phone are up to date but the Spotify keeps pausing randomly, what should I do?
My Spotify keeps pausing when I get notifications @SpotifyCares

clusters.label: app_crash
clusters.definition: App crashing on launch, freezing, black screen, iOS or Android bugs, app not optimized for new device (e.g. iPhone X), or requests for compatibility updates.
clusters.example: @SpotifyCares update the iPhone X app please
sample_messages: @SpotifyCares update the iPhone X app please
@115888 when will you have an update for the iPhone X?
When the fuck will the damn app be optimized for the iPhone X @115888?
@SpotifyCares @115888 Please release a new update to be compatible with iPhone X!
Another @115888 update and still no iPhone X support

clusters.label: account_login
clusters.definition: Login errors, inability to sign in, Facebook connect issues, credentials not working, account access lost after Facebook account deletion, or forgotten password.
clusters.example: @SpotifyCares I deleted my facebook account which was linked to my Spotify account. I can't log anymore into Spotify
sample_messages: @SpotifyCares I deleted my facebook account which was linked to my Spotify account. I can't log anymore into Spotify :( Any help/tips?
@SpotifyCares Hi there. Having some difficulties logging into Spotify via Facebook.
@SpotifyCares hi guys, my spotify wont log in, please help
@SpotifyCares I haven't used my Spotify account in a long time and now that I try to login if I try my email it says I am using my Facebook credentials.
Can't login to my account with facebook. please help

clusters.label: account_security
clusters.definition: Compromised accounts, unauthorized email or password changes, account takeover, unusual activity, hacking, or situations requiring immediate account freeze. HIGH RISK — always escalate.
clusters.example: @SpotifyCares my account suddenly logged me out on all devices and says my email doesn't exist anymore
sample_messages: @SpotifyCares my account suddenly logged me out on all devices and says my email doesn't exist anymore
@SpotifyCares someone hacked my spotify and changed the email and password
@SpotifyCares my account was hacked please help
@SpotifyCares I received an email that my account email was changed but I did not request this
@SpotifyCares there is unauthorized activity on my account

clusters.label: billing_dispute
clusters.definition: Being charged without having Premium, double charges, unauthorized transactions, account billed after cancellation, payment showing as processed but account still showing as free. HIGH RISK — always escalate.
clusters.example: @SpotifyCares you guys charged my account even though I don't have premium!
sample_messages: @SpotifyCares you guys charged my account even though I don't have premium!
@SpotifyCares I have been getting charged for the past year and I have the free subscription
@SpotifyCares I canceled Spotify months ago! And I noticed recently I'm still getting charged the premium rate.
@SpotifyCares i did paid to premium, but my current status is still free
@SpotifyCares Hi! I have subscribed to premium account a few hours ago and payment was validated, but turns out, my account is still free.

clusters.label: subscription_refund
clusters.definition: Explicit requests for refunds, charges after cancellation refund requests, disputed payment refund claims. HIGH RISK — always escalate.
clusters.example: @SpotifyCares I want a refund I was charged after I cancelled
